meta.notes: Region 2, crude first (playtest 1c, 2026-09-30, roadmap change [decided]: "Pnw and sf first then others"). Grey-green palette with the riders' own saturated colours on top; the palette keys follow the render look's material kinds (sky, water, road, shoulder, land, rail, deck) plus fog, foliage, trunk and accent for the render lane's palette hook. The look calls for drizzle; weather stays reserved, so the time-of-day lighting names carry it until weather lands. Traffic mixes this pack's placeholder vehicles (each reuses an existing shape) with base's pickup and rental. Every name and line is a placeholder the maintainer may veto.
